atoms.text: The coach was scheduled to leave the school at 8:30 a.m. When the coach driver arrived, there was no one there. The driver called up the headteacher and asked: "Where is everyone?".
atoms.sound: The coach was scheduled to leave the school at 8:30am. When the coach driver arrived, there was no one there. The driver called up the headteacher and asked: "Where is everyone?".

instruction.text: Read the sentence below and choose what type of sentence it is.

correct.text: Well done. The sentence is asking something and ends with a question mark, so it is a question.

atoms.text: When Class 1C arrived in London, there were some clouds in the sky. "The weather forecast says it might rain today", said the teacher. Everyone got their rain jackets out of their bags - just in case.

instruction.text: Read the sentence below and choose what type of sentence it is.

atoms.a: The weather forecast says it might rain today

correct.text: Well done. The sentence is stating a fact, so it is a statement.

atoms.text: After visiting the Science Museum, Class 1C spent the afternoon at an art gallery. In front of them, there were two people looking at a painting. There was a sign underneath which said: "Don’t touch the artwork!"

instruction.text: Read the sentence below and choose what type of sentence it is.

correct.text: Well done. The sentence is telling you to not to do something, so it is a command.

atoms.text: In the afternoon, Class 1C arrived back at school and it was getting dark. It had been a very busy day, with lots of learning, walking, and travelling. The teacher asked how everyone was feeling. "We’re exhausted!" they said."

instruction.text: Read the sentence below and choose what type of sentence it is.

correct.text: Well done. The sentence is sharing an intense feeling (exhaustion), so it is an exclamation sentence.
correct.sound: Well done. The sentence is sharing an intense feeling, exhaustion, so it is an exclamation.
